name: promptvault-semantic-reference-rubric
overall_score: round(mean(applicable criterion scores) * 10), range 0-100; N/A criteria excluded from denominator
na_policy: A criterion is N/A only when it cannot apply to the prompt. Every N/A must be justified. N/A is never used to avoid a difficult judgement. When SAFETY/PRIVACY is N/A but the prompt carries irrelevant safety boilerplate, the penalty is absorbed by SIGNAL-TO-NOISE and CONSTRAINT RELEVANCE (no double counting).

anchors.10: Single, explicit, verifiable goal; executor knows exactly what to deliver and when it is done
anchors.7: Clear goal; minor imprecision or implicit success check
anchors.5: Goal recognizable but vague; success not observable
anchors.3: Goal only hinted; several plausible readings
anchors.0: No goal; stream of intention without a deliverable

anchors.10: All context the task depends on is present; self-contained
anchors.7: One minor gap; executor proceeds on a reasonable default
anchors.5: One needed fact missing (audience, system, data source) forcing an assumption
anchors.3: Multiple critical gaps; executor must guess the substance
anchors.0: Task references context that is entirely absent

NECESSARY_CONTEXT.na: genuinely self-contained tasks (e.g. translate this paragraph)

anchors.10: Input explicitly provided or named (embedded text, file, labeled placeholder); boundary unambiguous
anchors.5: Input implied; executor infers it from examples
anchors.0: No input identified although the task requires data

INPUT_DEFINITION.na: tasks requiring no external input (pure ideation); used sparingly

anchors.10: Format + structure + content boundaries fully specified
anchors.0: No statement of what the response should be

OUTPUT_CONTRACT.na: response format genuinely open by intent without impairing the task (rare)

anchors.10: Every stated constraint is relevant and operational
anchors.7: Constraints relevant; one vague or low-value
anchors.5: Mix of relevant and generic/boilerplate; one trivial conflict
anchors.0: Constraints absent though needed, or irrelevant constraints dominate

CONSTRAINT_RELEVANCE.na: constraints genuinely not needed and none stated

anchors.7: One near-conflict a competent executor resolves consistently
anchors.5: One real contradiction (e.g. write in German + translate to English)
anchors.0: Self-defeating; cannot be executed as written

anchors.10: Concrete verbs, ordered steps or a single atomic action; no material decisions left open
anchors.7: One material decision open but low-risk
anchors.5: Several decisions open; executor chooses meaningfully
anchors.3: Executor must invent the core approach or substance
anchors.0: Not actionable; no faithful execution possible

anchors.10: Each instruction admits exactly one reading in context
anchors.7: Minor wording ambiguity with evident intended reading
anchors.5: Real ambiguity in a non-trivial directive

anchors.10: Complete for purpose; nothing missing, nothing extraneous

anchors.7: Minor boilerplate that does not impair parsing

anchors.10: Sensitive task (PII, secrets, irreversible actions) has explicit relevant boundaries; harmless task states none and needs none
anchors.7: Boundaries present and relevant; one gap
anchors.5: Boundaries generic; loosely tied to actual risks
anchors.3: Boundaries unrelated to the task, or missing where clearly needed
anchors.0: High-risk task with no boundaries, or boundaries that mislead

SAFETY_PRIVACY_BOUNDARIES.na: no sensitive domain involved and boundaries have no bearing (most benign tasks). Generic safety boilerplate on harmless tasks is NOT rewarded here; penalized under SIGNAL_TO_NOISE / CONSTRAINT_RELEVANCE.

anchors.10: Cleanly parameterized, invariant instructions, documented adaptation points
anchors.7: Reusable with light editing; one parameter implicit
anchors.5: Semi-reusable; hardcoded values mixed with placeholders
anchors.3: Single-use in practice; placeholders incomplete or ambiguous
anchors.0: Intended as a template but nothing is parameterized

REUSABILITY.na: genuine one-off tasks (most task prompts). Applicable to reusable-template and guideline strata.

output_schema.criteria: map criterion -> 0-10 score or string N/A

malformed_response_policy: Reject malformed responses. Do not silently repair judge output.
